name: NeuralRadianceFieldPackedRenderer
definition: A neural field renderer for pipelines combining NeuralRadianceField and PackedRFTracer. Registered as a default fallback for BaseNeuralField subclasses using PackedRFTracer. Capable of reducing tracer settings to lower quality during interactive mode.
summary: NeuralRadianceFieldPackedRenderer is a differentiable renderer for NeRF pipelines that integrates tightly with PackedRFTracer and supports interactive mode to maintain real-time performance.
